meta.projection_model: xgboost (single-net aggregate re-decomposed to sum6) + aging fallback
meta.note: Forward 2026-27 team detail. Player ratings aged to 2026-27; MPG is the selected minutes contract's display value (V3 uses active-game MPG); 'exp GP' is the expected games-played model. Wins contributed = each player's exact-additive share of the team's projected wins (sums to the projected total). A forward projection, not a measured result.
